comments.author: Chester
comments.body:
In addition to Hans comments, it will be very important to get an aide with "flameshot defence" skill (notably Chester does that).

Also another useful hint regarding to save MCT, is to get a junk lvl 52 Vaisseau, and bring down its max dura to 50%. Max dura can't drop below 50%, thus you won't give a shiit to crit hit.

With flameshot defence turned on, those ships do only 100-200 damage to you on average crit (or much less if distance is far).

Once you are in ideal position (aligned right next to edge), turn off flameshot defence except in time of urgency (can't repair due to eating food, rescuing). The prof. u got from evasion is somehow related to the damage u avoided, and flameshot defence slices away some total damage before you could evade...
